proxies.known_divergence: an empty interface used as a DI key or a type-test target is excluded although the container may register it
proxies.proxy: an interface declaring no methods, properties or events

proxies.known_divergence: a service whose API is property-shaped (an options accessor, IOptions<T>.Value) is excluded although composition chooses it
a service that merely returns another service's result (a repository returning an IReadOnlyList) reads as a factory
proxies.original_predicate: composition chooses the factory; the factory chooses later
proxies.proxy: Func<>, Lazy<>, IServiceProvider, IServiceScopeFactory, or an interface with a method or property returning an abstraction

proxies.known_divergence: a generic service abstraction that is not dispatch (IRepository<T>) reads as dispatch; resolved by registration until a declaration supplies the edge (CG-R-61)
proxies.original_predicate: the type parameter is the act
proxies.proxy: an interface with generic arity above zero that is not a factory

proxies.known_divergence: an abstract class registered only through a wrapper the resolver does not read is excluded although it is a service
proxies.proxy: an abstract class no registration names as a service

proxies.known_divergence: a primitive the container does supply (an options-bound connection string) is excluded
proxies.proxy: a struct, enum, delegate, string or object
